mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions and strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate above 4.5% and unemployment rate below 4.5% signals monetary tightening amid labor market strength, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential construction and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown and weak economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2300.0 (thousands of units) signal strong residential market activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST > 2300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods where INDPRO > 105.0.
